text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu basked in the public 
spotlight. Those around her hoped she 
would step down from the front lines to 
dedicate herself to the racing world 
alongside Symboli Rudolf, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu chooses to keep running. The 
Trainer feels the exact same way. 
Together, they devise a plan to convince 
those around them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win high-profile races even in the Senior 
Year to establish a commanding presence. 
Fire up Symboli Rudolf and drag her onto 
the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she will prove it: it is only by 
continuing to run that racing can truly 
evolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer considers which race to enter 
to make that happen. First, to 
re-establish her dominance in the mile 
division, they set their sights on the 
Victoria Mile.
